title: A library that feels calm and organized
summary: Manage your entire personal document collection in clean grid or list views, with automatic cover art extraction, custom collections, and favorites.
screenshotAlt: Lirune Reader main library interface showing grid view with book covers and search
points: Auto-generates crisp covers from EPUB, PDF, CBZ, and FB2 metadata
Instant library search by title or author with Ctrl+K shortcut
Custom collections and one-click favorites to organize reading queues
Sort by title, author, date added, or last read

title: A reading experience you can adjust your way
summary: Tailor typography, line spacing, margins, font sizing, and page layout to your exact reading preferences.
screenshotAlt: Lirune Reader typography and theme configuration screen
points: Refined themes including Dark, OLED Black, Light, Nord, Dracula, and Sepia
Choose from system fonts, serif book fonts, or monospace
Customizable line height (1.2 to 2.4) and page margin controls
Choose between paginated two-page spread, single page, or continuous vertical scroll

title: More than just EPUB: 19 document formats
summary: One unified, private reader for your ebooks, PDFs, office documents, comic archives, and markdown notes.
screenshotAlt: Lirune Reader integrated PDF viewer with zoom controls and clean layout
points: Standard ebooks: EPUB 2/3, FictionBook (FB2, FBZ), and Kindle (MOBI, AZW, AZW3)
PDF documents with high-fidelity rendering and zoom controls
Office documents: Word (DOCX, DOC), OpenDocument (ODT), and Rich Text (RTF)
Comic book archives: CBZ, CBR, and CB7 with smooth page turning

title: Your reading stays strictly personal
summary: 100% offline-first architecture. No account required, zero telemetry, and your books never leave your device.
screenshotAlt: Lirune Reader local storage management and backup export controls
points: No account registration, no login, and no passwords
Books and metadata stay in sandboxed local IndexedDB or SQLite storage
Zero telemetry, tracking pixels, analytics, or remote logging
Export complete library backups to a single JSON archive anytime

title: Find your place again with study tools
summary: Interactive table of contents, in-book text search, bookmarks, highlights, and Markdown annotation export.
screenshotAlt: Lirune Reader table of contents panel and chapter navigation
points: Expandable multi-level table of contents with filterable search
In-book full-text search with match counters and navigation
Multi-color highlights and custom notes attached to text spans
Export annotations and highlights directly to clean Markdown files

title: Exclusive Scroll Engine v2 on Android
summary: Experience fluid 60fps virtualized continuous scrolling on your phone or tablet, with zero internet permissions.
screenshotAlt: Lirune Reader Android app running continuous scroll reader
points: Scroll Engine v2 provides unified continuous reading across books
Network permission permanently stripped: android.permission.INTERNET removed
Android Storage Access Framework (SAF) folder browsing and direct imports
Built-in offline text-to-speech audio narration with speed controls
